title: Saanson Mein Tu
prompt: Modern Bollywood romantic pop ballad with lush cinematic strings, tender piano, fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a light dholak groove, yearning and tender yet quietly hopeful, polished radio-ready production, warm expressive male playback vocal with soft female harmonies, velvety intimate timbre
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Haan...) dheere se tu aa
Saanson ko chhoo ja

[Verse]
Raaton ki khamoshi mein
Teri baat goonjti hai
Har ek tanha lamhe mein
Teri yaad dhoondhti hai

[Pre-Chorus]
[building energy]
Jab tu paas aata hai
Waqt thehar sa jaata hai

[Chorus]
Tu hi woh chaaon hai dhoop mein
Tu hi sukoon hai is rooh mein
Tere bina ye din adhoore
Tujhse hi poore, TUJHSE HI POORE

[Verse 2]
Baadal jab barse aankhon se
Tu hi to chhata ban jaata
Andhere raaste pe mere
Tu chand bankar muskuraata

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
[harmonies]
(Thaam le haath mera)
Na chhode kabhi yeh saath
(Reh ja tu sang mere)
Har subah aur har raat

[Outro]
Tu hi woh chaaon hai...
Saanson mein tu... (dheere se)
